Bottom line

SPY +0.71% to 765.37, reclaiming its 50% Fib (764.28) but stalling under the 50-day (766.72; high 767.73). AI names led after Anthropic filed for a Nasdaq IPO (ANT); oil fell ~2% on Iran diplomacy. Fed decision Wednesday; GOOGL/MSFT/NOW Wed, AMZN Thu, XOM Fri.

Movers: TSLA +5.2% (Barclays upgrade to Overweight, $450 PT; back above 200-day). LMT +5.1% (Morgan Stanley upgrade to Overweight, $835 PT; 14-month high). BE +5.5%. GOOGL −1.1% to a 60-day low.
